description:
Listed
Building Consent: Works related to dry rot removal including window repairs, conservation works to external walls, erection of scaffolding
tied to the building, Doff cleaning, repointing brickwork, cutting back paving, installing gravel drainage channel, installation of new lath and plaster
ceiling with the provision of new ceiling hatch where ceiling has collapsed.
Linseed paint to whole building.
decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-size:12pt">The works hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this consent.</span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt">REASON: &nbsp;To comply with the provisions of Section 18 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990.</span></p><p><br data-cke-eol="1"></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt">Following removal of the scaffolding the effected fabric shall be made good within 1 month and retained as such thereafter.</span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt">REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt">&nbsp;Suitable precautions shall be taken to secure and protect features against accidental loss or damage during the building work hereby granted, and no such features may be disturbed or removed, temporarily or permanently, except as indicated on the approved drawings or with the prior approval in writing of the local planning authority.<br>REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt">If previously unknown evidence is discovered about historic character which would be affected by the works hereby granted, an appropriate record, together with recommendations for dealing with it in the context of the scheme, shall be approved in writing by the local planning authority before any of the permitted works are begun. The works shall be completed in accordance with the approved details.<br>REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building.</span></p><p><br data-cke-eol="1"></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt">All new external and internal works and finishes and works of making good to the retained fabric shall match the existing adjacent work with regard to the methods used and to material, colour, texture and profile, unless shown otherwise on the drawings or other documentation hereby approved or required by any conditions(s) attached to this consent.<br>REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">Prior to the start of the external works hereby approved, there shall be another check/ observation of sett 2 as identified in the approved ecology reports, and then the mesh cover, up to 2m away from the old sett entrance shall be re-installed, and a more permanent solution for hard blocking (paving or a rockery or similar, even oversized pots) shall also be installed to discourage badgers from digging to attempt reopening. If hardstanding is to be proposed, details are to be provided to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to their commencement. Any such works shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved details.</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">Reason: To protect ecology on the site and protect the special interest of the Listed Building.</span></span></p>
